summary: Stores the double value arriving in x87 register ST(2) as a 32-bit float into the field at offset 0x8 of the object addressed by this (ecx/a1). Parameters a3..a6 are not referenced by the body. The __userpurge convention carries the value in an x87 stack register rather than the argument list.

operations.description: Store the double arriving in x87 ST(2) as a float into the field at this+0x8 (field:this:0x00000008, RW).
Implicit void return; parameters a3..a6 are unused by the body.

unresolved: Identity of the owning object and the semantic meaning of the field at offset 0x8 are unknown.
Parameters a3..a6 have no use in the body; their purpose is caller-determined.
The value arrives via x87 ST(2), an artifact of the __userpurge calling convention.
